name: resume-controls
symptom: After make play-resume, UI controls such as Next Turn appeared not to work.

diagnosis.cause: JSON restoration recreated presentation actors that incremented Director pending actions, but no matching action remained to decrement the transient counter.

fix: CivApp::LoadSavedGame calls Director::NotifyResync after restored UI setup to clear transient pending/end-turn state.
regression: ui-resume-controls injects SDL mouse motion/down/up, asserts TurnButton down state, and requires round 1 to advance to round 2.
